issue: Review PR adding new API endpoints

observations.detail: The totalAmount calculation (sum of quantity * unitPrice) was stored as raw floating-point without rounding, which can produce artifacts like 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004. Extracted a shared calculateTotalAmount() helper that rounds to 2 decimal places via Math.round(x * 100) / 100. This also eliminates the duplicated calculation logic between create() and update().

observations.summary: Extracted calculateTotalAmount helper to eliminate DRY violation
observations.detail: The totalAmount reduce calculation was duplicated in OrderStore.create() and OrderStore.update(). Extracted into a single exported calculateTotalAmount(items) function in order.ts, used by both methods. This ensures consistent calculation logic and makes it easier to change the rounding strategy in the future.

observations.summary: Added 4 new edge-case tests bringing total to 51
observations.detail: Added tests for: (1) totalAmount rounds to 2 decimal places on create (0.1 + 0.2 = 0.3), (2) totalAmount rounds correctly on update, (3) NaN quantity rejection, (4) fractional quantity rejection (1.5). These verify the rounding fix and confirm that Number.isInteger() already guards against non-integer quantities.

observations.summary: Currency amounts should always be rounded to 2 decimal places
observations.detail: Any monetary calculation in this API (totalAmount, unitPrice arithmetic) should use Math.round(x * 100) / 100 to prevent floating-point precision issues. This convention is now documented in docs/api/orders.md and enforced by the calculateTotalAmount helper.
